chunks: And Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Minqarī narrated from Ḥafṣ ibn Ghiyāth, or someone else, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who divorced his wife, and they had a child between them. Which of the two has more right to him?
He عليه السلام said: "The woman, so long as she does not remarry."

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled; having the stronger legal right
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; here, the mother of the child
key_terms.امْرَأَتَهُ: his wife; the divorced woman in question
key_terms.تَتَزَوَّجْ: she remarries; the condition affecting her continued priority in custody
key_terms.طَلَّقَ: divorced; refers to the dissolution of the marriage by the husband
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: a child; the child over whom custody is disputed

ai.seo_question: Who has more right to child custody after divorce in this hadith from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding custody after divorce when a child is involved. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the mother has the greater right to the child so long as she does not remarry.
